headline: Mooring County Settles Under Warden Flag as Expanse Blazes
war_summary: Since our last edition, the Mooring County question has been settled on the map: every one of its twelve strategic posts now flies the Warden flag, the last Colonial holdings there having changed hands, though the fighting itself cools from its earlier fury. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's cauldron, with eighty-three base actions in a day and Wightwalk again the busiest ground at thirty-six; the tally of three Warden, two Colonial and four ruined posts stands unchanged while the twenty-four-hour butcher's bill climbs past eight thousand Colonial and eleven thousand Warden, and faster by the hour. Callahan's Passage has raised no new flag since yesterday evening, yet its losses accelerate sharply on both sides, each side near four thousand three hundred for the day. The Nevish Line and Linn Mercy likewise keep heavy casualty ledgers without altering their base counts. Stlican Shelf stays in motion about Briar, where the lone Warden post still holds. Day 571 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
